title: Comparison of Efficacy and Safety of Two Different Types of Botulinum Toxin Type A in Moderate to Severe Cervical Dystonia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare two types of botulinum toxin type A to treat the involuntary muscle contractions in the neck
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with cervical dystonia/spasmodic torticollis for at least 18 months
* Successfully treated previously with botulinum toxin type A

Exclusion Criteria:

* Breast feeding, pregnant or could become pregnant
* Surgery or spinal cord stimulation for cervical dystonia
* Previous injections of phenol, alcohol for cervical dystonia
